prescribedGeometry.description: Exact A1.1 prescribed display paths with zero axial half-separation, coincident endpoint orbit centers, one common frequency, and independently selected remaining A1 coordinates.

choices: The flattening coordinate lambda_A=0.35 is illustrative.
Every binary midpoint is the braid origin in the relative frame; h_a=0 and rho_a=R_a make each endpoint pair traverse one common geometric circle.
The common frequency f=0.25 and all remaining binary coordinates are prescribed display choices within A1.1.
Normalized linear axis interpolation is illustrative between the taxonomy-defined endpoints.
